She sits deep in the gaming chair, leaning slightly forward, her right hand reaching toward a desk beside her. The setting is a cozy, dimly lit gaming room — to her left, a dark desk with a glowing PC monitor, a black tower PC, desktop speakers, and a mechanical keyboard. The room is bathed in a soft purple-blue ambient LED glow from behind the setup, mixing with the pink of her chair and headphones. The monitor casts a faint cool light on the side of her face. Shot from above at close range, tight framing from her thighs up to just above her headphones. Shallow depth of field, the gaming setup softly blurred.
